_note: Landing copy for / (Banglish, lang=bn-Latn) and /en/ (English, lang=en). Source of truth is this file; Figma frames 22:113 / 25:544 (Banglish) and 27:931 / 27:1770 (English) show the layout. {{VERSION}}, {{APK_MB}}, {{SHA256_SHORT}} are filled at build time from the latest GitHub release.

title.en: Harkara — No signal? Harkara gets through.

description.bn: Dhaka-r off-grid messenger. Internet chhara-o Bluetooth, hall-er Wi-Fi, SMS ba QR diye message, kaaj, khata ar map. Free, open source, signup nai.
description.en: An off-grid messenger for Dhaka. Messages, errands, IOUs and maps over Bluetooth, local Wi-Fi, SMS or QR when the internet is down. Free, open source, no sign-up.

lead.bn: Tomar message phone theke phone-e haath-bodol hoye pouchay. Net thakle internet relay, na thakle Bluetooth, hall-er Wi-Fi, SMS ba QR.
lead.en: Your message travels hand to hand, phone to phone. Over internet relays when there is a connection; over Bluetooth, campus Wi-Fi, SMS or a QR code when there isn’t.

meta.bn: Android 8+ · Free · Signup nai · Open source (AGPL-3.0)
meta.en: Android 8+ · Free · No sign-up · Open source (AGPL-3.0)

betaNote.bn: Beta — kichu feature porer update-e ashbe. Ki ki kaaj kore, release note-e dekho.
betaNote.en: Beta — some features arrive in later updates. See the release notes for what works today.

detail.en: An old phone on a charger, hall Wi-Fi
Lifts the message onto the internet

footnote.bn: Server nai, taka lage na. Message shudhu se-i porte pare jar jonno pathano.
footnote.en: No server, no cost. Only the person it’s meant for can read it.

h2.bn: Net gele-o 6 ta rasta khola thake.
h2.en: Six ways through when the network is down.

lead.bn: Load-shedding, bonna, concert-er bhir — jekhane network more jay. Harkara nije bujhe nay kon rasta kaaj korche, ar message oi pothe pathay.
lead.en: Power cuts, floods, a packed concert — wherever the network gives out. Harkara works out which route is open and sends your message that way.

detail.bn: Pashe-r Harkara phone-gulo message haath-bodol kore, 7 hop porjonto.
detail.en: Nearby phones running Harkara pass messages along, up to 7 hops.

detail.bn: Kachhe karo data thakle, tar phone tomar message internet-e tule dey.
detail.en: If someone nearby has data, their phone lifts your message onto the internet.

detail.bn: Charger-e lagano puraton phone, hall ba dokan-er Wi-Fi-te. Net lage na.
detail.en: An old phone on a charger, on a hall or shop Wi-Fi. No internet needed.

detail.bn: Tomar SMS app-e text likha thake, tumi shudhu send dao.
detail.en: The text is written into your SMS app; you just press send.

detail.bn: Screen-e dekhao, o scan korbe. Sob radio off thakleo cholbe.
detail.en: Show it on screen, they scan it. Works with every radio off.

detail.bn: Kono rasta na thakle jomano thake, rasta khullei chole jay.
detail.en: With no route open it waits, and goes the moment one opens.

detail.bn: Public relay diye shara shohor, shara desh. Kono nijossho server nai.
detail.en: Public relays reach the whole city and beyond. No server of our own.

lead.bn: Panch ta tab — Nearby, Chats, Tasks, Khata, Me. Proti ta kaaj upore-r rasta-gulor jei ta khola, oi ta diye chole.
lead.en: Five tabs — Nearby, Chats, Tasks, Khata, Me. Each one runs over whichever of those routes is open.

body.bn: Nilkhet-e jam, canteen-e khichuri shesh, library-te seat khali — 3 km-er moddhe sob post, nijer nam chhara. Meyad shesh hole post nije-i mile jay.
body.en: A jam at Nilkhet, the canteen out of khichuri, free seats in the library — posts from within 3 km, no name attached. Each post fades when it expires.

text.bn: Khichuri shesh, kintu dim bhaji ache. Line ekdom choto.
text.en: Khichuri’s gone, egg bhaji still on. Short queue.

title.en: Groups, DMs and “everyone on this Wi-Fi”

body.bn: Class group, mess group, ba hall-er Wi-Fi-te jara ache. Message end-to-end encrypted; relay-o porte pare na. Choto voice note mesh-eo jay.
body.en: Class groups, flat groups, or everyone on the hall Wi-Fi. End-to-end encrypted — relays can’t read it. Short voice notes travel over the mesh too.

in.en: Lab’s cancelled! Everyone to the canteen

out.en: Coming, 5 min. Order me a tea

title.en: Ask for help, or help out

body.bn: Nilkhet theke photocopy, gate theke parcel — kaaj post koro, taka bolo. Hand-off hoy QR ba 6 digit code-e, net chhara-o.
body.en: Photocopies from Nilkhet, a parcel from the gate — post the errand and name a price. Handoff is a QR or 6-digit code, even offline.

title.en: 2 sets of photocopies, Nilkhet to TSC

body.bn: Mess bill, canteen baki, CNG share — IOU tokhon-i pakka jokhon duijon-i sign kore. Settle korle bKash TrxID likhe rakho.
body.en: Flat bills, canteen tabs, a shared CNG — an IOU counts only once both people sign. Settle up and note the bKash TrxID.

body.bn: Dhaka-r map ekbar namao, tarpor net lagbe na. Pani-r filter, charging point, raat-er pharmacy pin koro; bondhu-der sathe share koro.
body.en: Download the Dhaka map once and it works without internet. Pin water filters, charging points, late-night pharmacies; share them with friends.

detail.en: Next to the hall canteen, open 24 h

title.en: Let them know you got there

body.bn: Ek tap-e “Hall-e pouchhe gechi” — net na thakle SMS-e. Bondhu-der sathe 1 ghonta live location, tarpor nije-i bondho.
body.en: One tap for “Back at the hall” — by SMS if there’s no internet. Share live location with friends for an hour, then it stops by itself.

body.bn: Compass, Qibla, torch-e Morse SOS, Bangla-English emergency handbook, file pathano. Sob optional — off thakle battery khay na.
body.en: Compass, Qibla, Morse SOS on the torch, a Bangla-English emergency handbook, file sending. All optional — switched off, they use no battery.

sosTitle.en: Hold the status pill for 3 seconds

sosDetail.bn: SOS ar location jay sob khola rasta-y, ekshathe
sosDetail.en: Sends SOS and your location over every open route

h2.en: From one phone to the whole hall.

lead.bn: Mesh tokhon-i kaaj kore jokhon pashe aro keu Harkara chalay. Duita kaaj, kono-tai net lage na.
lead.en: A mesh only works when people nearby run Harkara too. Two ways to grow it, neither needs internet.

title.en: Share the APK phone to phone

detail.bn: Hotspot ba QR diye bondhu-ke app dao. Play Store, data, kichu lage na.
detail.en: Hand the app to a friend over hotspot or QR. No Play Store, no data.

title.en: Set up a node in your hall

detail.bn: Puraton phone + charger + hall-er Wi-Fi. Map, handbook, APK sob okhan theke pawa jay.
detail.en: An old phone, a charger and the hall Wi-Fi. It serves the map, the handbook and the APK.

detail.bn: GitHub Releases theke. Beshirbhag phone-er jonno arm64, {{APK_MB}} MB.
detail.en: From GitHub Releases. arm64 for most phones, {{APK_MB}} MB.

detail.bn: Android jiggesh korbe “Install unknown apps”. Oi browser-er jonno ekbar on koro.
detail.en: Android will ask about “Install unknown apps”. Turn it on once for that browser.

detail.bn: Number, email kichu lagbe na. Area bachho, feed chole ashbe.
detail.en: No phone number, no email. Pick your area and the feed loads.

verifyNote.bn: Download-er por mile dekho. Protiti update ek-i signing key-te.
verifyNote.en: Check it after downloading. Every update is signed with the same key.

otherAbis.en: Older phone? There’s an armeabi-v7a APK too.

lead.bn: Na pele GitHub-e issue kholo. Code-o okhane, khola.
lead.en: Can’t find it? Open an issue on GitHub. The code is there too.

q.en: Do I need a phone number?

a.bn: Na. Signup nai, number nai. Phone-e ekta key toiri hoy, oi ta-i tumi. Backup nijer kache rakho.
a.en: No. No sign-up, no number. Your phone makes a key, and that key is you. Keep a backup yourself.

a.bn: Na. Mesh, map, live location — sob off thake jotokhon na tumi nije chalu koro. Lite mode-e aro kom khay.
a.en: No. Mesh, maps and live location stay off until you turn them on. Lite mode uses even less.

a.bn: Shudhu jake pathaiso. Message end-to-end encrypted; relay, node ba pashe-r phone — keu porte pare na.
a.en: Only the person you sent it to. Messages are end-to-end encrypted; relays, nodes and the phones that pass them along can’t read them.

q.en: Why isn’t it on the Play Store?

a.bn: Free ar swadhin rakhte. APK GitHub-e, code open — je keu mile dekhte pare.
a.en: To keep it free and independent. The APK is on GitHub and the code is open, so anyone can check it.

a.bn: Ekhono na. iPhone-wala bondhu-ra link khule browser-e IOU confirm ar task follow korte parbe.
a.en: Not yet. Friends on iPhone can open a link to confirm an IOU or follow a task in the browser.

tagline.bn: Para-r app — bonna, load-shedding ar roj-er kaaj-er jonno.
tagline.en: A neighbourhood app for floods, power cuts and everyday life.

meta.bn: Made in Dhaka · v{{VERSION}} · No ads, no tracking
meta.en: Made in Dhaka · v{{VERSION}} · No ads, no tracking

body.bn: Ei page kono cookie, analytics ba tracker chalay na. Bhasha bachar jonno browser ekbar api.country.is-ke shudhu desh-er code jiggesh kore (kichu jomay na). Tumi nije bhasha bachle oi check ar hoy na.
body.en: This page uses no cookies, analytics or trackers. To pick a language, your browser asks api.country.is once for a country code (nothing is stored there). Once you choose a language yourself, that check stops.
